biography:
Rory is currently Director, Cloud Sales at Compass Datacenters.

In this role, he manages strategic relationships with hyperscale clients and leads end-to-end leasing cycles across the U.S. His leasing responsibilities include early-stage demand generation, oversight of technical qualification and due diligence, contract negotiation, and final lease execution. He is accountable for driving growth and delivering excellence in partnership with the world’s largest companies.
